# MCP surface â€” `c3 mcp` (milestone 10)

`c3 mcp` runs a stdio MCP server: newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 on stdin/stdout (the MCP
stdio transport). It exposes C3's **read-and-record** tools to a coordinator model (Claude
Code, or any MCP client) and nothing else. Per design Â§9 and invariant 3 (*C3 never
commits*), there is **no commit or finish tool**, and no interactive tool (`complain`,
`forget-me`) is exposed.

Implementation: `crates/c3/src/mcp/mod.rs` (the server) and `crates/c3/src/cli/mcp.rs` (the
subcommand). The server is dependency-light â€” a hand-rolled JSON-RPC loop over serde_json,
no async runtime.

## How each tool runs

Every tool re-invokes the running `c3` executable (`std::env::current_exe()`) as a child
process with the matching CLI arguments and captures its stdout / stderr / exit code. This
guarantees the files a tool writes are **byte-identical to a CLI run** and isolates each
tool's locks and timeouts in a child process. The child inherits the environment and the
server's working directory (the repository the coordinator runs in); its stdin is closed.

Path-shaped arguments (`collab_dir`, `brief`, `out`, `focus[]`, `artifact[]`) are rejected
if they are absolute or contain a `..` component that escapes the working directory
(`c3-core::task_slug::contained_join`).

Timeouts: `c3_consult` gets 3600 s (a consultation may take minutes); every other tool gets
120 s. A timeout kills the child and the tool result is flagged `isError`.

A tool result is `content: [{ "type": "text", "text": <console output + exit code> }]` plus
`isError` (true on a non-zero exit or a timeout). Logging goes to stderr only under
`C3_DEBUG=1`.

## Protocol methods

| Method | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `initialize` | Echoes the client's `protocolVersion` (default `2025-06-18` if absent); capabilities `{ "tools": {} }`; serverInfo `{ name: "c3", version }`. |
| `notifications/initialized` | Notification (no `id`) â€” no response. |
| `tools/list` | The tool definitions below. |
| `tools/call` | Runs the named tool; result as described above. |
| `ping` | Empty result `{}`. |
| unknown method | JSON-RPC error `-32601` (method not found). |
| malformed line | JSON-RPC error `-32700` (parse error), `id: null`. |

## Tools

Each maps to a `c3` subcommand. `collab_dir` (default `.collab`) is accepted by every tool
that has one; omitted from the argument column below for brevity.

| Tool | Input schema (required in **bold**) | Runs |
|---|---|---|
| `c3_providers` | `provider?`, `short?`, `no_network?` | `c3 providers [--provider] [--short] [--no-network]` |
| `c3_consult` | **`task`**, **`purpose`**, **`brief`**, **`prompt`**, **`reply_name`**, `mode?`, `thread?`, `provider?`, `model?`, `effort?`, `max_words?`, `timeout_sec?`, `continue_sec?`, `range?`, `artifact?[]`, `raw?`, `dry_run?`, `skip_preflight?`, `off_peak_only?`, `codex_config?[]`, `schema_transport?`, `format_retry?`, `telemetry?` | `c3 consult â€¦` (may take minutes; a background panel with detach/status is **not** available yet â€” milestone 4) |
| `c3_findings_list` | **`task`**, `all?` | `c3 findings --task â€¦ --list [--all]` |
| `c3_findings_stats` | **`task`** | `c3 findings --task â€¦ --stats` |
| `c3_findings_status` | **`task`**, **`id`**, **`status`**, `note?`, `evidence?` | `c3 findings --task â€¦ --id â€¦ --status â€¦ [--note] [--evidence]` |
| `c3_rate` | **`task`**, **`n`**, **`useful`**, `note?` | `c3 findings --task â€¦ --rate <n> --useful â€¦ [--note]` |
| `c3_scoreboard` | `task?`, `json?` | `c3 scoreboard [--task] [--json]` |
| `c3_pack` | **`brief`**, **`out`**, `focus?[]`, `budget?`, `task?` | `c3 pack --brief â€¦ --out â€¦ [--focus] [--budget] [--task]` |
| `c3_explain` | **`claim`**, `focus?[]`, `budget?`, `audience?`, `out?` | `c3 explain --claim â€¦ --yes [--focus] [--budget] [--audience] [--out]` (always passes `--yes`; the pack is meant to leave the machine) |
| `c3_snapshot` | `out?`, `delta?`, `depth?`, `budget?`, `focus?[]` | `c3 snapshot [--out] [--delta] [--depth] [--budget] [--focus]` |
| `c3_telemetry_status` | *(none)* | `c3 telemetry status` |

Not exposed: `complain` and `forget-me` (interactive), `panel`/`index` (not built), and
anything that commits â€” there is no such tool.

## Registering the server in Claude Code

Add a `.mcp.json` at the repository root (the server inherits that repo as its working
directory):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "c3": {
      "command": "c3",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

If `c3` is not on `PATH`, use the absolute path to the built binary as `command`.

## Invariant

**No tool commits.** Every tool only reads the repository and records consultation
artifacts (briefs, replies, ledger entries, findings, packs, snapshots) as files. `git
add`/`commit` and the eck finish loop stay with the coordinator â€” C3 never commits.

1: # MCP surface â€” `c3 mcp` (milestone 10)
   2: 
   3: `c3 mcp` runs a stdio MCP server: newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 on stdin/stdout (the MCP
   4: stdio transport). It exposes C3's **read-and-record** tools to a coordinator model (Claude
   5: Code, or any MCP client) and nothing else. Per design Â§9 and invariant 3 (*C3 never
   6: commits*), there is **no commit or finish tool**, and no interactive tool (`complain`,
   7: `forget-me`) is exposed.
   8: 
   9: Implementation: `crates/c3/src/mcp/mod.rs` (the server) and `crates/c3/src/cli/mcp.rs` (the
  10: subcommand). The server is dependency-light â€” a hand-rolled JSON-RPC loop over serde_json,
  11: no async runtime.
  12: 
  13: ## How each tool runs
  14: 
  15: Every tool re-invokes the running `c3` executable (`std::env::current_exe()`) as a child
  16: process with the matching CLI arguments and captures its stdout / stderr / exit code. This
  17: guarantees the files a tool writes are **byte-identical to a CLI run** and isolates each
  18: tool's locks and timeouts in a child process. The child inherits the environment and the
  19: server's working directory (the repository the coordinator runs in); its stdin is closed.
  20: 
  21: Path-shaped arguments (`collab_dir`, `brief`, `out`, `focus[]`, `artifact[]`) are rejected
  22: if they are absolute or contain a `..` component that escapes the working directory
  23: (`c3-core::task_slug::contained_join`).
  24: 
  25: Timeouts: `c3_consult` gets 3600 s (a consultation may take minutes); every other tool gets
  26: 120 s. A timeout kills the child and the tool result is flagged `isError`.
  27: 
  28: A tool result is `content: [{ "type": "text", "text": <console output + exit code> }]` plus
  29: `isError` (true on a non-zero exit or a timeout). Logging goes to stderr only under
  30: `C3_DEBUG=1`.
  31: 
  32: ## Protocol methods
  33: 
  34: | Method | Behaviour |
  35: |---|---|
  36: | `initialize` | Echoes the client's `protocolVersion` (default `2025-06-18` if absent); capabilities `{ "tools": {} }`; serverInfo `{ name: "c3", version }`. |
  37: | `notifications/initialized` | Notification (no `id`) â€” no response. |
  38: | `tools/list` | The tool definitions below. |
  39: | `tools/call` | Runs the named tool; result as described above. |
  40: | `ping` | Empty result `{}`. |
  41: | unknown method | JSON-RPC error `-32601` (method not found). |
  42: | malformed line | JSON-RPC error `-32700` (parse error), `id: null`. |
  43: 
  44: ## Tools
  45: 
  46: Each maps to a `c3` subcommand. `collab_dir` (default `.collab`) is accepted by every tool
  47: that has one; omitted from the argument column below for brevity.
  48: 
  49: | Tool | Input schema (required in **bold**) | Runs |
  50: |---|---|---|
  51: | `c3_providers` | `provider?`, `short?`, `no_network?` | `c3 providers [--provider] [--short] [--no-network]` |
  52: | `c3_consult` | **`task`**, **`purpose`**, **`brief`**, **`prompt`**, **`reply_name`**, `mode?`, `thread?`, `provider?`, `model?`, `effort?`, `max_words?`, `timeout_sec?`, `continue_sec?`, `range?`, `artifact?[]`, `raw?`, `dry_run?`, `skip_preflight?`, `off_peak_only?`, `codex_config?[]`, `schema_transport?`, `format_retry?`, `telemetry?` | `c3 consult â€¦` (may take minutes; a background panel with detach/status is **not** available yet â€” milestone 4) |
  53: | `c3_findings_list` | **`task`**, `all?` | `c3 findings --task â€¦ --list [--all]` |
  54: | `c3_findings_stats` | **`task`** | `c3 findings --task â€¦ --stats` |
  55: | `c3_findings_status` | **`task`**, **`id`**, **`status`**, `note?`, `evidence?` | `c3 findings --task â€¦ --id â€¦ --status â€¦ [--note] [--evidence]` |
  56: | `c3_rate` | **`task`**, **`n`**, **`useful`**, `note?` | `c3 findings --task â€¦ --rate <n> --useful â€¦ [--note]` |
  57: | `c3_scoreboard` | `task?`, `json?` | `c3 scoreboard [--task] [--json]` |
  58: | `c3_pack` | **`brief`**, **`out`**, `focus?[]`, `budget?`, `task?` | `c3 pack --brief â€¦ --out â€¦ [--focus] [--budget] [--task]` |
  59: | `c3_explain` | **`claim`**, `focus?[]`, `budget?`, `audience?`, `out?` | `c3 explain --claim â€¦ --yes [--focus] [--budget] [--audience] [--out]` (always passes `--yes`; the pack is meant to leave the machine) |
  60: | `c3_snapshot` | `out?`, `delta?`, `depth?`, `budget?`, `focus?[]` | `c3 snapshot [--out] [--delta] [--depth] [--budget] [--focus]` |
  61: | `c3_telemetry_status` | *(none)* | `c3 telemetry status` |
  62: 
  63: Not exposed: `complain` and `forget-me` (interactive), `panel`/`index` (not built), and
  64: anything that commits â€” there is no such tool.
  65: 
  66: ## Registering the server in Claude Code
  67: 
  68: Add a `.mcp.json` at the repository root (the server inherits that repo as its working
  69: directory):
  70: 
  71: ```json
  72: {
  73:   "mcpServers": {
  74:     "c3": {
  75:       "command": "c3",
  76:       "args": ["mcp"]
  77:     }
  78:   }
  79: }
  80: ```

  82: If `c3` is not on `PATH`, use the absolute path to the built binary as `command`.
  83: 
  84: ## Invariant
  85: 
  86: **No tool commits.** Every tool only reads the repository and records consultation
  87: artifacts (briefs, replies, ledger entries, findings, packs, snapshots) as files. `git
  88: add`/`commit` and the eck finish loop stay with the coordinator â€” C3 never commits.
